summary.text: Historical data is provided by S&P Global Market Intelligence. Real-time stock price data is provided by CBOE and 15-minute delayed consolidated tape pricing data is provided by Nasdaq UTP. Several fund data points are also provided by Finnhub.

overview.description: The AB US Equity ETF (XCHG) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in total market equity. The fund is an actively managed ETF that invests in equity securities of US companies across mid- and large-cap segments. The fund aims for long-term capital appreciation XCHG was launched on Dec 12, 2025 and is issued by AB Funds.

holdings.infoBox: XCHG is an equity ETF with a total of 579 individual holdings. The top holdings are NVIDIA stock at 8.39%, Microsoft at 6.72%, Alphabet at 5.81%, Apple at 5.55%, and Amazon.com at 4.75%.
